name: Document Desk
description: Keep your documents in one searchable library. Add PDF, Word, Markdown, web page, spreadsheet and text files, or share a folder and the library stays in step with it. Find passages by meaning, exact phrase or pattern, and read them as clean text.
author: Vakyartha

documents.reason: Document Desk keeps the files you add and the folders you share as searchable text.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search the person's Document Desk library. mode smart (default) ranks documents by relevance and returns the best passages with their section and line; "quoted phrases" must appear and -word leaves documents out. mode exact finds lines containing the text; mode regex finds lines matching a regular expression. Read-only.

tools.name: read_document
tools.title: Read a document
tools.description: Read up to about 12,000 characters of one Document Desk document as Markdown, from a line (use a search result's line) or from offsetLine. more says whether text continues; read on from toLine + 1. Read-only.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List Document Desk documents, most recently updated first, optionally with one tag. Returns id, title, kind, source, status, words, pages and tags. Read-only.

skills.name: document-desk-reader
skills.description: Answer questions from the person's own documents in Document Desk: search, read the passage, and cite it.
